text: Pro and Fast questions: a switch next to the send button shows how many of each you have left (2 Pro and 5 Fast a day free; 8 and 25 with Premium, and unused ones carry over), and answers about new games look things up on the web and use our guides

👍 and 👎 on every answer; Gemini Pro for Premium and for "where is it?" and puzzle questions; answers use a checked guide first, with a "From the guide" badge; and controller-friendly show/hide shortcuts (hold View + Menu by default)

quick questions you can tap instead of typing ("What should I do next?", "Anything missable here?" and more), in all nine languages and on the controller; and Quest Compendium is now on the Microsoft Store
a Report button on every answer, and fixes reach the guides more reliably

guide pages open with an area summary (region, level, quests, services, enemies, how to get there); the panel and the quest log show and hide on their own; and typing is instant again in long conversations
answers read where you are from your screen and remember what you've already done; missable entries say where to start, what to do and why they're missable; and entries in the same spot are merged

a friendlier quest log with details for every objective; answers add their key steps and warnings to it; fight help marks enemies in kill order with a battle plan; and on-screen markers are now optional
trim the quest log your way (hide entries, show 3, 6 or all), a backdrop slider, and Locate me: one press finds where you are (20 a day free, 100 with Premium)
the quest log follows where you are, built from our guides: what's missable, points of no return, things to collect, achievements and what's next, no question needed
on-screen objectives stay on your game when the panel is hidden, WoW-style; answers lead with the answer and flag what you can miss; and Ctrl+Space is the default show/hide shortcut
every guide shows its game's banner
every game with an achievement guide gets an "Achievements and roadmap" page, in your language
achievements always get their tip from the guide, whatever language Steam answers in
achievement help: how to get each one, what you can still miss, a roadmap to 100%, and the guide area where each one happens
search for games, and search inside a guide by area or item; guides follow your app language
Quest Compendium speaks nine languages, in the interface and the answers, and the in-app browser's ad blocker works again
